title: Derp Universe Definition Schemas
description: Comprehensive JSON Schema documenting all 17 definition tables used in Derp Universe. These definitions drive the data-driven game engine and are editable via the admin panel at /admin/def.

ItemType.description: The functional type of an item

RequirementType.description: Types of requirements that gate access to content

RewardType.description: Types of rewards/effects in outcome blocks

SkipType.description: How skip cost is calculated for timers

GiftRewardType.description: Types of rewards in gift definitions

BodySlots.description: Body slot positions for the avian_7 body schema

ModalActionType.description: Discriminant values for ModalAction — determines which fields are present on the action object

ModalBlockType.description: Discriminant values for ModalBlock — determines the block renderer and its fields

ButtonVariant.description: Visual style of a modal button

RichTextNodeType.description: Rich text node types. Block nodes (p, h1, h2, ul, li) contain child nodes. Leaf nodes (text, br, token) carry data. link adds an href field.

PlayerEventType.description: Tracked player event types for telemetry and quest progression

CheckInFrequencyType.description: How often a check-in window opens

Timer.description: Duration and skip settings for timed activities (missions, crafting, building)

boostable.description: Whether tick boosts affect this timer

skipable.description: Whether the timer can be skipped for a cost

Requirement.description: A single condition that must be met. Structure varies by type.

value-based.description: For types: keeper_level, team_size, flag, trait, building, currency, item

key.description: Identifier key (required for flag, trait, building, currency, item)

operator.description: Comparison operator (optional, defaults to gte for numeric)

ids-based.description: For types: has_building, has_room, parent_has_building, parent_has_room, in_region

ids.description: Array of IDs that satisfy the requirement

Requirements.description: Array of Requirement objects. All must be satisfied (AND logic).

RewardEntry.description: A single reward/effect entry in an outcome block. Structure varies by type.

payload.description: Key-value payload for the event handler

BundleEntry.description: A container grouping multiple reward entries with shared odds and requirements

odds.description: Percentage chance the entire bundle triggers

OutcomeBlock.description: Outcome definition containing a rewards array. Used for mission success/failure.

rewards.description: Array of reward entries and/or bundles

CostObject.description: Map of resource ID to amount. Used for crafting costs and skip costs.

ResourceEntry.description: Canonical resource entry format used in level-based rules

CostEntry.description: Cost entry in level rules (extends ResourceEntry)

ProductionEntry.description: Production rate entry in level rules

StorageEntry.description: Storage capacity entry in level rules

LevelBlock.description: Configuration for a specific level within level-based rules. Sparse entries inherit downward via resolveLevelConfig().

constructionCost.description: Cost to build/upgrade to this level

LevelRules.description: Top-level rules object with level-based configuration. Uses singular 'level' key containing numbered level blocks.

level.description: Map of level number (string key) to LevelBlock. Sparse entries inherit downward.

stats.description: Map of stat name to bonus value

BodySlots.description: Map of body slot to array of allowed archetype names

SlotStats.description: Nested map of body slot to stat bonuses for a trait archetype

EquipmentSlotSchema.description: Map of equipment slot name to max count

GiftPresentation.description: Visual presentation properties for a gift

expiresInSeconds.description: Seconds until gift expires (null = no expiry)

GiftRewardSpec.description: Reward specification for gifts. Structure varies by type.

AssetRef.description: Reference to a media asset by key, with optional alt text

assetKey.description: Key used to resolve the asset URL (e.g. via /media/*)

RichTextNode.description: A single node in a rich text document tree. Leaf nodes carry data; block nodes contain children.

block.description: Container nodes: p, h1, h2, ul, li, strong, em, code

token.description: Named placeholder resolved at render time (e.g. player name, entity name)

RichTextDoc.description: An ordered array of RichTextNode objects representing formatted text

RewardItem.description: Display-only reward entry used inside rewardsPreview and rewardsList blocks

ModalTelemetry.description: Optional analytics metadata attached to a modal for tracking display and interaction events

sourceType.description: What triggered the modal (e.g. mission, gift, system)

templateId.description: Template or def ID that produced this modal

ModalAction.description: Action triggered when a modal button is pressed. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

CLOSE_MODAL.description: Dismiss the modal with no side effects

params.description: Route params or query string values

COMPLETE_JOB.description: Complete a job (mission, crafting) and collect its rewards via the command pipeline

CLAIM_GIFT.description: Claim a gift for the player

REPEAT_MISSION.description: Re-launch a mission with the same def and optional entity team

CRAFT_AGAIN.description: Re-submit a crafting job for the same recipe

API_CALL.description: Make an arbitrary API call identified by a stable key

apiKey.description: Stable identifier mapped server-side to an endpoint

payload.description: Arbitrary key-value payload forwarded to the endpoint

ModalButton.description: A button rendered at the bottom of a modal

id.description: Stable button ID for deduplication and telemetry

requiresConfirm.description: If set, tapping this button shows an inline confirmation prompt before executing the action

ModalBlock.description: A single content block rendered in the modal body. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

image.description: A full-width image with optional caption

metaRows.description: A table of label/value pairs (e.g. mission stats, item properties)

timer.description: Countdown timer block that ticks in real time

endsAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the timer expires

rewardsPreview.description: Read-only preview of potential rewards (shown before an action)

rewardsList.description: Claimed rewards list (shown after a completed action)

inventoryDelta.description: Shows inventory changes (items added or removed with signed quantities)

giftReveal.description: Animated gift reveal block showing a gift and its contents

ModalHeader.description: Header section of a modal containing title, optional subtitle, icon, and banner image

icon.description: Small icon shown beside the title

banner.description: Full-width banner image shown above the title

ModalSpecV1.description: Server-authoritative modal specification (version 1). The backend constructs this object; the frontend renders it declaratively via GameModal. Used for mission results, gift reveals, crafting completion, notifications, and any other game event that requires a rich popup.

id.description: Stable modal ID used for deduplication in the modal stack

kind.description: Semantic kind (e.g. mission_complete, gift_reveal, generic_info) for telemetry and styling hints

dismiss.description: Controls which gestures can dismiss the modal

body.description: Ordered list of content blocks rendered between the header and the buttons

buttons.description: Action buttons rendered at the bottom of the modal (typically 1–2)

CheckInFrequency.description: Controls how often a check-in window opens

interval.description: Used with every_x_days; number of days

CheckInDayReward.description: A reward entry for a specific check-in day

day.description: 0-indexed day in cycle (or 1-indexed — match to streak % cycleLength)

giftDefId.description: GiftDef to issue when this day is claimed

QuestObjective.description: A single objective that must be completed as part of a quest

key.description: If set, also matches PlayerEvent.key. Null = any key

target.description: Total amount needed to complete this objective

dataFilter.description: Optional shallow key-value match against PlayerEvent.data (e.g. {outcome:"success"})

Currency.description: Data-driven currency definitions with type, caps, and trade rules

ItemDef.description: Item definitions with rarity, stacking, binding, equipment, consumable, and crafting metadata

EntityDefinition.description: Character/entity blueprints referencing body, equipment, and progression schemas

BodySchema.description: Defines body slots and which archetypes are allowed per slot

slots.description: Map of slot to allowed archetypes

EquipmentSchema.description: Defines equipment slot types and max counts per slot

schema.description: Map of slot to max count

ProgressionProfile.description: Defines leveling, ascension, mastery, and prestige capabilities for entities

TraitDefinition.description: Trait archetypes with per-slot stat bonuses. One record per archetype.

archetype.description: Display name of archetype (e.g. Dave, Astro)

slotStats.description: Nested map of slot to stat bonuses

RegionDefinition.description: World regions that locations belong to, with biome and modifier data

id.description: Unique identifier (snake_case, matches DB regionId format)

LocationDefinition.description: Location blueprints with production profiles, level-based rules, buildings/rooms allowance, and requirements

rules.description: Level-based rules (workers, buildings, rooms, storage, production, construction costs)

BuildingDef.description: Building blueprints with level-based rules (production, storage, construction costs) and requirements

RoomDef.description: Room blueprints (rooms belong to buildings) with level-based rules and requirements

DisplayDef.description: Universal display definitions for visual card styling, referenced by missions and categories

MissionCategoryDef.description: Hierarchical mission categories with display properties, tags, and access requirements

MissionDef.description: Mission blueprints with success/failure outcomes, timers, difficulty, and requirements

RecipeDef.description: Crafting recipe definitions with costs, timers, rewards, and requirements

cost.description: Crafting cost (map of resourceId to amount)

EventDefinition.description: Server-side event definitions with handler functions and access control

GiftDef.description: Gift definitions with presentation, claiming rules, and reward specifications

instant.description: If false, claim creates a GIFT_PACKAGE item; player opens via OpenGiftPackage command

LootboxDef.description: Defines a lootbox with weighted outcome pools. Items with type=LOOTBOX reference a LootboxDef via data.lootboxDefId.

iconKey.description: Asset key for the lootbox icon

outcomes.description: Weighted outcome pool (same format as MissionDef rewards)

rollCount.description: Number of independent rolls per open

CheckInDef.description: Defines a check-in track with per-day gifts and frequency rules. Multiple tracks run independently per player.

cycleLength.description: Streak wraps after this many days

requireStreak.description: If true, missing a window resets streak to 0

allowReclaim.description: If requireStreak=true and streak resets, allow re-claiming day 0 gift

QuestDef.description: Defines a quest with objectives matched against player telemetry events.

objectives.description: List of objectives; all must complete to finish quest

crossReferences.description: Foreign key relationships between definition tables
